tools.name: canvas_inspect
tools.title: Inspect canvas
tools.description: Canvas size, current revision, layers, frames (with durations), tags and active layer/frame. Call this first and whenever you need the latest revision.

tools.name: canvas_snapshot
tools.title: Look at the canvas
tools.description: Your eyes: returns a PNG image of a frame (all visible layers, upscaled for viewing) plus a JSON summary of content bounds and used colors. Use after drawing to check your work.

frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.

onion.description: Onion skin: {before, after, opacity 0-255, tint}. Shows neighbouring frames faintly underneath.

opacity.description: Opacity of the nearest onion frame.

tint.description: Tint previous red and next blue.

background.description: Optional background color for the image.

tools.name: get_pixel
tools.title: Read pixel
tools.description: Reads one pixel's color from a layer (or the composited frame with composite=true).

layer.description: Layer index (0 = bottom) or exact layer name. Defaults to the active layer.

frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.

composite.description: Read the final image of all visible layers instead of one layer.

tools.name: read_region
tools.title: Read pixels
tools.description: Reads a rectangle of pixels (max 128x128) as text. format 'ascii' (default) gives one string per row with a color legend ('.' = transparent) — ideal for reasoning about shapes; 'hex' gives colors; 'indexed' gives palette indices.

width.description: Region width (default: to the canvas edge).

height.description: Region height (default: to the canvas edge).

layer.description: Layer index (0 = bottom) or exact layer name. Defaults to the active layer.

frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.

tools.name: set_pixel
tools.title: Paint pixel
tools.description: Paints a single pixel.

color.description: Color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (or 'transparent'). New colors are added to the palette automatically.

layer.description: Layer index (0 = bottom) or exact layer name. Defaults to the active layer.

frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.

expectedRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency: fail with 'conflict' if the canvas revision differs (get it from canvas_inspect or any previous result).

operationId.description: Idempotency key: retrying with the same id never applies the change twice.

tools.name: set_pixels
tools.title: Paint pixels

color.description: Default color for entries without one.

layer.description: Layer index (0 = bottom) or exact layer name. Defaults to the active layer.

frame.description: 0-based frame index. Defaults to the active frame.
